models.notes: Official API model ID muse-image-1.0 on Meta Model API (Responses API and the OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits endpoints). Flat $0.01 per generated image regardless of prompt length, size (which only sets the aspect ratio), reasoning_strength, reference images or the built-in web and image search; a request for n images is billed for n, and images that fail or are removed by safety filtering are not billed. No Batch or Contributor-mode rate. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date.

models.notes: Official API model ID muse-spark-1.3, the latest Muse Spark version and Meta's recommendation for new work. Text, image, video, audio and PDF input; text output; 1,048,576-token context window. Muse Spark 1.2 and 1.1 remain available at the same Standard price and are not listed separately. Contributor-mode variants trade training use of your content for a lower price and are noted, not listed as separate rows. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy (restricted territories excluded). Meta does not publish a maximum output length, Batch rate or release date in the API docs; unknown values are not represented as zero.

price_records.billing_note: Standard mode pay-as-you-go pricing on Meta Model API, shared by muse-spark-1.3, 1.2 and 1.1. Cached input applies to tokens served from a cached prompt prefix. No long-context premium. Contributor mode (muse-spark-1.3-contributor) costs $0.10 input, $0.002 cached input and $0.20 output per 1M tokens in exchange for letting Meta use prompts and responses to train future models; it is not used as the default rate. Web search grounding is billed separately at $2.50 per 1,000 queries.

models.notes: Official API model ID muse-voice-transcribe-1.0: speech to text over the realtime WebSocket endpoint (wss://api.meta.ai/v1/asr/realtime) or the file endpoint POST /v1/asr/transcribe. $0.18 per hour of audio processed, the same for streaming and file transcription. Streaming diarization, endpointing, keyword biasing and 25 evaluated languages; no word-level timestamps. Null V1 token fields mean not applicable, not free. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date or Batch rate.

price_records.billing_note: Meta Model API pay-as-you-go price for audio processed, metered in whole seconds (rounded down). Streaming (realtime WebSocket) and file transcription cost the same, and zero data retention is priced at parity. Contributor mode is not available.

models.notes: Official API model ID sam-3.1 (Segment Anything Model 3.1) on Meta Model API through the Responses API: text prompt, image or video in, boxes and pixel masks out. Billed per image ($2.50 per 1,000) and per video frame ($0.20 per 1,000, at least 50 frames per video request), not per token. Null V1 token fields mean not applicable, not free. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date.

price_records.billing_note: Image segmentation at $2.50 per 1,000 images on Meta Model API. Video segmentation costs $0.20 per 1,000 frames, with each video request billed for at least 50 frames (usage.video_frames_processed reports the frames billed); the dataset has no per-frame unit, so the video rate is kept in this note. Streaming and non-streaming requests cost the same.
